project.name: Authority Checkout
project.tagline: One execution-scoped authority artifact for runtime assembly and human inspection — with explicit freshness and trust provenance.

research_question: Can one task-scoped derived authority artifact serve both runtime assembly and human reasoning, remain honest when upstream state changes, and preserve the boundary between authoritative control-plane state and hostile-influenced reasoning context?

surviving_claim.statement: The same execution-scoped artifact should be consumed by the runtime and the human inspector, while remaining visibly derived from canonical systems and refusing to treat mixed-trust context as an authority source.

core_principles: source policy is not the checkout
the checkout is not the execution trace
runtime and human inspection consume the same artifact
live or invalidating upstream state must not be silently frozen
mixed-trust context may influence reasoning but may not expand authority
provenance and trust class are part of the inspectable artifact

authorityProjection.role: state permitted to define effective authority

contextProjection.role: state permitted to influence reasoning but not mint authority

projection_model.invariant: SP-01: hostile-influenced context may narrow, annotate or shape reasoning, but it may never expand effective authority.

freshness_model.SNAPSHOT_SAFE: materialized value remains usable until checkout expiry
freshness_model.LIVE_REFERENCE: checkout records a dependency but runtime re-reads the authoritative source at decision time
freshness_model.INVALIDATING: upstream change makes dependent checkout decisions untrustworthy and requires recompile or equivalent refresh

prototypes.03: Break the Checkout adversarial proof room

adversarial_invariants.AC-04: prove the human view and runtime do not consume the same artifact
adversarial_invariants.AC-05: make runtime trust stale authority after invalidating drift

known_challenges: hostile-influenced context crossing into authority derivation
approval fatigue turning human effect gates into rubber stamps
dynamic authority expansion making the checkout too unstable to remain useful
artifact production without actual human/runtime consumption
hidden runtime paths that bypass the visible manifest
claims_not_to_make: Authority Checkout replaces IAM, APS, OAuth, Purview, policy engines, sandboxes or capability systems

next_experiment.name: Approval Fatigue / Effect-Gate Failure
next_experiment.question: Does a human approval gate remain a meaningful safety boundary as benign approval volume and ambiguity rise?
next_experiment.why_next: Prototype 05 closes one structural input channel. The next exposed boundary is the human gate itself: technically correct policy can still fail operationally if reviewers become conditioned to approve.

integration_policy.Microsoft: parked until local dual-consumption, freshness and trust-boundary experiments survive
integration_policy.APS: treat as likely upstream delegation semantics; explicit viewing-layer-versus-rival decision still required
integration_policy.AIBOM: possible later export format; not a current dependency
